headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal want £55M in any Gyökeres deal
description: Arsenal has set their valuation for Viktor Gyökeres' transfer fee if the striker does depart in the next year. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Wayne Rooney: Bruno Fernandes, Man United players acting like 'babies'
description: Wayne Rooney has lambasted Manchester United's squad for acting like "babies" and urged Bruno Fernandes and Lisandro Martínez to look in the mirror.

headline: Erling Haaland set to return with Man City 'hungry' to continue perfect start
description: Manchester City coach Enzo Maresca said Erling Haaland is available for Saturday's trip to Aston Villa, while three other players remain doubtful.

headline: Who's to blame for Man United mess: Carrick, the players ... Ratcliffe?
description: The bitter truth about United is that their prolonged and deep-rooted decline can be attributed to much more than their manager. Who deserves the most blame, and why?

headline: Michael Carrick set to lead Man United vs. Bournemouth amid pressure - sources
description: Michael Carrick is set to be in charge of Manchester United against Bournemouth this weekend, sources have told ESPN, as he battles to keep his job at Old Trafford.

headline: Bruno Guimarães: I had sleepless nights over Arsenal move
description: Bruno Guimarães has admitted he had sleepless nights over his decision to leave Newcastle United for Arsenal.
